name: HC39:  No. of AYPs under the care of peer group models who are suppressed
description:
Number of AYPs active in HIV care under YAPS whose latest valid viral load result as of :endDate is suppressed.
Patient meets HC38 logic; latest valid VL on or before :endDate has is_suppressed = 1; patient remains active in care.

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT h.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_health_education h
WHERE h.encounter_datetime <= :endDate
  AND h.dsdm_approach = 'YAPS'
  AND h.encounter_datetime = (
      SELECT MAX(h2.encounter_datetime)
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_health_education h2
      WHERE h2.patient_id = h.patient_id
        AND h2.encounter_datetime <= :endDate
        AND h2.dsdm_approach IS NOT NULL
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode v
      WHERE v.patient_id = h.patient_id
        AND v.is_valid_result = 1
        AND v.is_suppressed = 1
        AND COALESCE(
            v.viral_load_clinical_date,
            v.sample_collection_date,
            v.laboratory_result_date,
            v.order_date
        ) = (
            SELECT MAX(
                COALESCE(
                    v2.viral_load_clinical_date,
                    v2.sample_collection_date,
                    v2.laboratory_result_date,
                    v2.order_date
                )
            )
            FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode v2
            WHERE v2.patient_id = h.patient_id
              AND v2.is_valid_result = 1
              AND COALESCE(
                  v2.viral_load_clinical_date,
                  v2.sample_collection_date,
                  v2.laboratory_result_date,
                  v2.order_date
              ) <= :endDate
        )
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
      WHERE a.patient_id = h.patient_id
        AND (
            a.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
            OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );
